Also used as the classifier for some tools with jaws or openings, and for pens in formal contexts (though ด้าม is more common for pens).

draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and straightforward, identifying a basic feature of the body
notes: While 'ปาก' literally means mouth, it is frequently used in compound words to refer to other types of openings, such as the mouth of a river or the opening of a bag.
Be careful with this word when discussing people; while it means mouth, using it to describe someone as 'having a big mouth' (ปากใหญ่) can imply that they talk too much or are indiscreet.
